segments.copy: He explained that GLP-1 medicines can slow stomach emptying. The stomach normally mixes food and moves it into the small intestine. When that takes longer, the full feeling can linger—even after a small meal.
segments.visual: S01: Conditional educational comment→single stomach/duodenum model; movement then elapsed-time cue.
segments.evidence: General medication/physiology context previously verified. Personal symptoms not diagnosed. No UMS or brand here.

segments.copy: Fiber can help bowel regularity, and MiraLAX softens stool by holding water in it. Those jobs are different from speeding up stomach emptying. That was the distinction I'd missed.
segments.visual: S02: Separate colon/stool hydration illustration with accurate labels, then a small anatomical locator.
segments.evidence: Functional comparison after UMP. Do not generalize to fiber/MiraLAX never helping GLP-1 symptoms or the colon being innocent.
